scenes.text: Three *22-year-olds* built a *$2 billion* AI hiring machine

scenes.title: Who: *Foody, Hiremath & Midha*, 22
lines: Brendan Foody dropped out of Georgetown; Thiel Fellow.
Mercor, 2023: AI interviews that match experts with AI labs.

scenes.title: The *hackathon*
lines: The idea took shape at a hackathon in Sao Paulo.
$1 million run rate in nine months.
"I've worked every day for the last three years."

scenes.title: The *AI* part
lines: Candidates do a 20-minute video interview with an AI.
Mercor then places doctors, lawyers and coders to train AI models.
Contractors keep 60 to 70% of what the labs pay.

scenes.title: The *numbers*
lines: Experts average $95 an hour, from $20 to $375.
Over 100,000 freelancers, about 30,000 active each week.
A $350 million round at a $10 billion valuation made them the youngest self-made billionaires.

scenes.title: The *catch*
lines: Gross run rate counts what labs pay; most of it goes to the experts.
A March 2026 vendor breach paused work with Meta.
Fortune, Nov 29, 2025; The Next Web, July 10, 2026; 60 Minutes, Oct 4, 2026.

scenes.text: Want to *get paid* training AI? Comment *EXPERT* and follow.
